Heyman, Türkiye’nin bölgesel ve uluslararası etkisini giderek artırdığını vurgulayarak, İsrail’in Ankara’ya karşı izlemesi gereken yolun doğrudan askeri mücadele değil, siyasi ve diplomatik araçlarla şekillendirilmesi gerektiğini savundu. ‘TEL AVİV’İ ATEŞE ATIYOR’ Heyman analizinin en dikkat çekici bölümünde, Türkiye ile İran’ın aynı kefeye konulmasına sert biçimde karşı çıktı. “Türk tehdidini İran tehdidiyle kıyaslayan herkes Türkiye’nin büyüklüğünü anlamıyor ve onlara iyilik yapıyor. transfer.title: Premier League paradox: midfielders are more and more expensive, yet more and more mediocre | Jonathan Liew
transfer.summary: Enzo Fernández and Sandro Tonali had big-money summer moves, but can they hold a candle to past greats? Perhaps the only thing you really need to know about the modern midfield role is that Enzo Maresca reckons that Marc Guéhi can play it better than Mateo Kovacic. Guéhi, in reality a centre-back, started the season in midfield for Manchester City, ahead of Kovacic, the now-departed Nico González, and Matheus Nunes. In this context City’s purchase of Enzo Fernández for a club record £125m can be seen in one of two ways: either an enormous statement of intent, or a hell of a lot of money to pay for Guéhi’s understudy. We jest, of course. Fernández is in fact a very different kind of midfielder to Guéhi, largely on the basis that he actually is a midfielder. Versatile, able to receive deep from the goalkeeper or the centre-halves; capable of recycling or progressing the ball in tight spots, driving into final-third positions as a No 8, ghosting into the penalty area and offering an advanced goal threat.
